name: Date Treat
source:
This game was made by NomnomNami as an April Fools... prank? I guess! All of the characters appear in the [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/lonely-wolf-treat]Lonely Wolf Treat[/url] series, so please play those first to be able to enjoy this little game to its fullest!

[From in-game description]
